name: SplitCraft SMP
description:
🌸 SplitCraft 🌸

Build under the starry sky

splitcraft.net • Java + Bedrock, consoles too

Survival, but it actually matters.

Two worlds, one you. Your items, money, homes and claims work in both, and /world takes you between them.

✦ Celestia: our amplified world. Huge mountains, fresh land and long nights (10 minute days, 20 minute nights). Its Nether is brand new: floating islands, giant caves and huge pillars.

❀ Floralia: the original world, full of cherry groves and old builds. 30 minute days, 30 minute nights.

When the sun sets, PvP turns ON in the wild. Build walls, carry a sword, stay alert. The Nether and the End are PvP all the time. The lobby and your claims are always safe.

🛡 Claim your land

* 15×15 plots from bedrock to sky, $1,000 for your first claim

* Lasts 30 days, extend whenever you like

* Let friends build with /trust

* Outside a claim, anything goes

💰 Earn just by playing

Mine ore. Kill mobs. Catch fish. Hit advancements. Log in daily for a streak bonus. Money lands automatically, no jobs to pick. Spend it at the Global Market, where everyone gets their own shop, or at the eight server traders. Trade safely with /trade.

📦 A personal /chest that's the same in every world, and pets (horse, camel, skeleton horse) that come when you call.

🧟 Base Build (new minigame)

Build a base in daylight, then survive the zombie night. One player turns into the alpha zombie and everyone who dies joins the horde. Make it to morning and humans win.

* 3 maps, up to 32 players

* An AI horde joins small rounds, so you can even play alone

* Starter kits, titles and live leaderboards

Join from the lobby.

✨ Stardust

Our network currency. Earn it by playing, voting or hanging out in the AFK zone, and spend it on spawners. Our spawners don't spawn mobs: loot and XP pile up inside, so no lag farms needed.

☠ Hardcore Mode (opt-in)

* HARD: mobs hit 20% harder, you get hungry faster

* INSANE: mobs hit 50% harder, no /chest, no pets

* CUSTOM: pick y
